_doc: Capability registry for orchestrator.py. Each entry: {invoke, filter (null=clean JSON / name=filters/<name>.py), status, desc, timeout?, contract{in,out}, test, doc}. invoke placeholders: bare {key} filled from args (missing→''); optional group [--flag {key}] kept only when key present, dropped otherwise (for flag+value pairs). 'native' = ported into capabilities/ reading crime-desk/config. 'delegated' = calls _oldrepo parts bin (clean --json, or via a filter) until natively ported. See ARCHITECTURE.md + handoffs/ + docs/orchestrator.md.

ledger.desc: SPEC 40 — per-signature outcome scoreboard. action=record|stats|backfill|migrate-spec69|migrate-spec90|migrate-spec110|migrate-watch. stats flags sizeable only at n>=10 AND hit%>50 AND total_r>0 (the §9 base-rate gate). Every thesis retire (§0.5 BREAKS) ends with one record call. SPEC 63: rows carry source (live/replay/backfill); stats adds by_source split (n/hit%/avg_r/total_r per source) and judges sizeable on LIVE rows only. canon_signature also maps the SPEC-59 setup keys. SPEC-110: signature taxonomy now admits unlock_cliff_fade/spring_reclaim_long; an unrecognized --signature fails loudly (unknown set + known list) unless --allow-new persists it verbatim. SPEC-172: --allow-new is now VERBATIM (no heuristic pass at all), and any *_watch signature (or direction=WATCH) is never heuristic-mapped into a trade signature — stats splits these into a `watch` bucket excluded from every trade aggregate; migrate-watch re-tags already-corrupted rows.

in.signature: str? (enum incl. unlock_cliff_fade/spring_reclaim_long, SPEC-59 setup keys, or free-form — canonicalized; unknown fails loudly unless allow_new)
in.allow_new: bool? (record — SPEC-110: persist an unrecognized --signature verbatim)

out.stats: {signatures:{sig:{n,hit_pct,avg_r,total_r,by_source{live/replay/backfill:{n,hit_pct,avg_r,total_r}},last_5,sizeable}}, watch:{sig:{n,tickers}} (SPEC-172: WATCH-tier rows, excluded from every trade aggregate)} or one row+records

inbox.desc: SPEC 45 — surveillance event inbox. op=list (default) returns unconsumed events from state/nonce_alerts.log + state/inbox_events.jsonl; op=ack --through-ts advances the atomic cursor. classify rows carry per-ticker {n,max_severity}; verdicts are NEVER overridden (§0.5).

onboard.desc: SPEC 47 — config-driven token onboarding. Resolves the coingecko id (SPEC 36 collision-safe), writes the tracked_wallets skeleton, pulls GoPlus top holders as tier:'unclassified' CANDIDATES (hard guard: excluded from radar seeding until the Designer tiers them via needs_judgment), seeds the nonce baseline. Idempotent: tracked tokens get a report-only read. SPEC 52: explicit coingecko_id bypasses symbol search; failures are stage-named (resolve_ambiguous+candidates / resolve_not_found / contract_fetch_failed / goplus_failed / baseline_failed). SPEC 51: '{"all":true}' sweeps every unmapped watchlist name (set-difference first; per-token failure never aborts). SPEC-165: an explicit `contract` (+ required `chain`) skips CoinGecko entirely — RPC-only identity (name/decimals/totalSupply) + GoPlus holders, for fresh BSC->Alpha names with no CoinGecko entry on day one.

in.coingecko_id: str? (explicit id — collision override, skips search)
in.all: bool? (sweep mode: onboard all unmapped watchlist names)
in.contract: str? (SPEC-165: explicit 0x.. contract — skips CoinGecko, requires chain)

out.new: {ok, ticker, cg_id, low_confidence, contracts, candidates_written, needs_judgment:[{address,balance_pct,hints}], baseline_seeded}
out.tracked: {ok, already_tracked:true, contracts, wallets, tiers, needs_judgment, baseline_seeded}
out.by_contract: {ok, ticker, onboarded_by:"contract", contracts, primary_chain, token_meta:{name,decimals,total_supply,meta_available}, candidates_written, needs_judgment, baseline_seeded}

thesis.desc: SPEC 48 — schema-validated §0.5 thesis lifecycle. op=commit validates the contract (rejects a commit with NO named invalidation) and stamps committed_ts/by; op=close|retire moves tokens→retired AND appends the outcome row to the SPEC-40 ledger (the §9 base-rate gate accumulates automatically). Atomic + lock-guarded watchlist writes. SPEC 63: commit takes an optional signature (SPEC-59 setup keys + discretionary); close takes exit_px -> mechanical pnl_r (entry_zone mid + stop; tp1/tp2 without exit_px estimated from the committed TP, flagged), and resolves the row signature without guessing (committed -> explicit -> inferred-only-if-confirm_signature -> else discretionary).

in.thesis: object (commit: direction, entry_zone, stop, tp, triggers[], invalidation{}, time_stop_h, setup?, signature?)
in.confirm_signature: flag? — write the inferred signature on a no-signature close

out.commit: {ok, ticker, op, thesis, warnings, commit_warning, geometry_warning (SPEC 61 — committed stop inside the full-history true-wick stop)}
out.close/retire: {ok, ticker, op, ledger_row, pnl_r, pnl_r_estimated, signature, signature_source, suggested_signature}

size.desc: SPEC 41 — mechanical §7 sizing gate: liquidity gate FIRST (AUTO-PASS <$10M vol/<$15M MC short-circuits; SCOUT-ONLY $10-25M = 50% final-size haircut), then size-to-exit ($ within band% of mid on the EXIT side across BOTH venue books — SHORT exits into bids, LONG into asks; truncated side = floor estimate ×0.5), OI cap 3%, bracket cap 70% tier-1 (config/brackets.json), leverage 1/stop-distance (practical 75%, haircut_dex_mark >30% DEX mark-weight), operator-cluster heat (config/clusters.json). Emits every constraint + which binds; max_size_usd ONLY when equity passed. Read-only. SPEC 61: --propose-stop returns stop_proposal (beyond the TRUE wick = max(24h extreme, full-history window extreme) + magnet-aware buffer, never AT a round; names cleared_wick/source) + entry_type_required:post_breakdown on chronic squeezers (>1 leg/10d) with a retest-zone warning.

in.equity: float? — account $ ; only then max_size_usd emitted
in.mc: float? — market cap $ for the gate
in.propose_stop: flag? — SPEC 61 true-wick stop proposal + entry-type guard

out.max_size_usd: float? — only with equity (min of $ caps × scout haircut)

maxsize.desc: SPEC-87 — pre-trade max-clean-size + slippage curve + venue routing (the execution-microstructure layer under size.py §7). Reuses depth.py's book fetchers (aster/bitget/binance + hyperliquid); walks the correct side (LONG entry / SHORT exit → buy ASKS; SHORT entry / LONG exit → sell BIDS), computes max_clean_usd = max notional fillable within --bps of mid (VWAP slippage, default 25), a $100–10k slippage ladder (realized bps + walks-to price), depth within 1%, and a truncation flag (book ends inside the band → clean-size is a FLOOR, defer to live DOM — never false capacity). Routing recommendation: cheapest self-custody/EXECUTABLE venue (aster/hyperliquid) for the requested --size (or largest clean ceiling), with a clip schedule when target > ceiling; binance/bitget tagged signal-only. Read-only intel — NO auto-verdict. Carries the calm-snapshot + calm-vs-flush (exit liquidity in a cascade is a fraction of this) + oracle-mark caveats (liq marked off the oracle, not this book — §7).

in.size: float? — target notional USD for routing/clip schedule

cvd.desc: SPEC 42 — spot-vs-perp CVD divergence with REAL spot-venue resolution: primary spot venue by 24h volume (Binance ↔ Bitget, then GeckoTerminal DEX pools via the tracked contract); spot CVD from THAT venue (Binance klines taker-buy fields / Bitget fills / GT trades with a declared taker-side heuristic), perp CVD from Binance futures klines (parity with the proven divergence math). Degrade-EXPLICIT: no spot anywhere → verdict UNAVAILABLE + spot_coverage none — analyse reads the §4 CVD leg as UNKNOWN, never a silent fail-the-gate.

out.taker_side_heuristic: str (DEX reads only — kind==taker side, declared)

stake_schedule.desc: SPEC 43 — unlock cliffs + catalysts from a staking/lock contract (RIVER methodology, ported from parts bin): chunked event-log scan over the window, primary event by topic[0] frequency, heuristic amount/endTime decode, forward unlock schedule by ISO week, CLIFF dates >=5% of decoded locked supply, optional write to config/catalysts.json. Token-mode (--token) scans Transfer-from-vesting for passive contracts. The §4 sub-pattern-B tell: lock contract + cliff ahead = vesting-hedge calendar; no lock contract = watch safe nonces instead. SPEC-165: any lock-mode call tries the UUPS unlock-escrow selector set FIRST (getUnlockSchedules()/getAvailableAmount()/withdrawnAmount()/startTime()) — decodes straight off it when present (mode:escrow, schedule_hash tripwire, mutable/owner_safes when owner-only setters exist on-chain), degrading to the event-log scan (with escrow_adapter_reason) when the selectors aren't there.

in.token: str? — TOKEN-MODE: scan Transfer events on this token where from=contract
in.catalyst: str? — ticker: write cliffs to config/catalysts.json (deduped)
in.float_supply: float? (SPEC-165) — escrow-mode cliffs are pct-of-float when given, else pct-of-decoded-locked-total

out.locked_total: float — decoded future unlocks (lock-mode) / current vesting balance (token-mode) / last cumulative step (escrow-mode)
out.schedule: lock: list[{week,amount,pct_of_locked}] ISO-week buckets. escrow: list[{date,amount,pct}] per decoded step
out.cliffs: list[{date,amount,pct}] — dates unlocking >=5% of the pct basis; [] clean on non-lock/non-escrow contracts
out.schedule_hash: str|absent — escrow-mode only, sha256(raw getUnlockSchedules() return)[:16], a changed schedule is itself the signal
out.mutable: bool|absent — escrow-mode only, true when an owner-only setter (setUnlockSchedules/setStartTime/emergencyWithdraw/upgradeToAndCall) is present in the bytecode
out.mutators: list[str]|absent — escrow-mode only, which owner-only setters were detected
out.owner_safes: list[str]|absent — escrow-mode only, owner() when mutable
out.escrow_adapter_reason: str|null — lock-mode only, why the escrow adapter didn't apply

tape.desc: SPEC 31 — per-minute OI/price/taker/liquidation microstructure classifier: labels each candle into the four-force vocabulary (longs/shorts opening/closing) and flags operator staged-play sequences (fake-breakdown short-recruitment, chain-squeeze through a round number, tail-of-liquidation, downtrend slam). Read-only intel — NO auto-verdict.

out.defended_fade: obj{wall_growing,snapshots,last_wall_notional_usd,last_mid,stall_lower_high}|null (SPEC-83 wall-dynamics from the history brief records; null if no history yet)

tape._note: Operationalizes the operator-seat OI lens (memory feedback_read_oi_price_from_operator_seat) — the SKYAI 2026-06-06 miss (flat tape was short-recruitment; flush→wick below 0.1836 then chain-squeeze through 0.20→0.2085). Deterministic candle classification (decision-tree=code); operator-INTENT judgment stays with the Designer (invariant 2). price+taker from 1m klines (taker-buy vol is in the kline → no raw-trade dump); ΔOI floor is 5m (openInterestHist period=1m returns [] → oi_interval:5m, each 1m bar inherits its 5m bucket's ΔOI, declared not pretended); liquidations via forceOrders are auth-gated on public REST → liq_available:false degrades-explicit (forced-vs-voluntary short-exit then undetermined; the split logic runs whenever a liq feed is supplied). Read-only — does NOT replace the §5 funding-flip+OI-build short gate; pairs with oi_sides (coarse wash) as the fine-grained sequence underneath.

brief.desc: SPEC 30 — one-call full-stack token read: state (classify) + perp (analyse) + venue books (depth: Aster execution venue first, then bitget+binance cross-check — SPEC-85) + on-chain (onchain), fused into one envelope so a bare ticker never returns a chopped-up partial. The Designer's session-default on any ticker.

in.render: str? — full (default) | compact (SPEC-193: decision-only, ~<=3KB, reason UNTRUNCATED, drops raw bars/depth/kline payloads + meta.layer_ms)

out.risk_card: obj (SPEC-169: the §9 risk-card line off the committed thesis geometry)
out.venue_bars: obj{available,venues,n_total,n_available,bars,dominant_tape,execution_venue,tape_agreement} (SPEC-188: the all-venue 1h OHLC sweep, printed unconditionally; tape_agreement is one checklist line per committed thesis level any venue crossed)
out.headline: str (SPEC-83: appends 'ask-wall GROWING ...' when the defended wall is thickening)
out.timed_out: [str] (SPEC-172: component names that exceeded their own budget; every OTHER component still returns normally — never an empty error)
out.meta: obj{layer_ms:{component:int}} (SPEC-172: wall-clock ms per component, timed out or not)

brief._note: Pure COMPOSITION over already-MERGED capabilities (classify/analyse/depth/onchain) — re-derives nothing, no new data sources. Layers run concurrently, each under its OWN wall-clock budget (SPEC-1b/SPEC-172): main-loop layers 90s, the post-loop batch (defended_fade/unlocks/venue_breadth/risk_card) its own smaller per-component budgets. Each section degrade-explicit (available:false+reason, never silent null, never a crash that loses the other layers) and a timed-out one is named in `timed_out` — never a silent full-call timeout (SPEC-172: a `with ThreadPoolExecutor` block's blocking shutdown was quietly re-imposing an abandoned thread's hang on the whole call; fixed via `_bounded()`, shutdown(wait=False)). venue omitted = BOTH Bitget+Binance books (kills the SKYAI single-venue exit-book blind spot, memory feedback_skyai_exit_liquidity_is_bitget). onchain.newly_fired = SPEC-24 token-out-gated confirmed fires; staging_vs_execution = SPEC 28. A READ, not a commit (§0.5): surfaces all data but state.verdict stays authoritative.

classify.desc: CONFIRMS/TRIGGERS/BREAKS per token vs its committed thesis (the daily board)

in.render: str? — full (default) | compact (SPEC-193: decision-only rows, no pretty-print indent, drops leverage_state + raw per-venue venue_agreement arrays; reason UNTRUNCATED)

out.thesis_drift: obj? — SPEC-91: null unless live price ran past the whole committed structure, else {stale,live_price,nearest_anchor,nearest_dist_pct,furthest_anchor,all_tps_printed,side}; reason then LEADS with ⏳ STALE-THESIS [DRIFT] … RE-ANCHOR
out.price_leg: obj? — {high,low,stop_breached,tps_printed,entered_zone,window,venue_agreement} | null; venue_agreement (SPEC-188 §3) is {label:FULL|PARTIAL|SINGLE,n_crossed,n_total,crossed,closed_beyond,size_book_venue} | null — annotation only, never changes verdict; the label is also appended to `reason` as "(tape: LABEL n/total)"
out.watch_leg: obj? — {breached,high,low,window,legacy,venue_agreement} | null; venue_agreement same shape as price_leg's, off the first breached watch_level

regime_flip._note: native --json verified Phase 0: emits {ticker,tag,note,funding_pi,...} clean (single-ticker dict; bare/multi → list).

in.tickers: str? — space-separated subset; omit for full watchlist
in.render: str? — full (default) | compact (SPEC-193: drops leverage_state + null keys)

triage._note: native port of the parts-bin triage.py (413L noisy CLI). build_board() = pure compute; --json = machine path; bare = human cards. funding_pi per-interval %, Bybit-preferred.

scan.desc: Cross-sectional DISCOVERY scanner: entire Bybit perp universe ranked by funding extremity (%/4h), liquidity-gated. Also a SCOUT board (--scout / --scout-signals, SPEC-82): runs the §6 setup_score scorers across the watchlist and partitions {scout,armed,quiet} — surfaces the near-armed ramp (score>=required-1) with add_triggers, even with no committed thesis. SPEC-84: --include-hl additionally merges HL-native perps (self-custody venue) into the universe; default off keeps the Bybit-only run byte-identical. SPEC-120: --mode faded_bounce screens the user's primary edge (off-ATH + bounced + faded volume + funding-flat + not-squeezing, tiered by distribution freshness where available) — an unrecognized --mode fails loudly, never a silent fallback to the default funding scan. SPEC-148: --mode oi_surge is a cross-sectional discovery net over Binance/Bybit/Bitget/Aster/Hyperliquid catalogs — flags cross-venue OI surges vs a persisted baseline (state/oi_surge_baseline.json), vol/OI brushing, funding extremity (SPEC-108/112 selection), and fresh listings; retires the manual loris.tools/markets browse.

in.oi_catalog: list? — oi_surge offline: [{ticker,venue,oi_usd,vol24h_usd,funding_raw_pct,interval_min,is_floor}] injected (no network, no baseline file I/O)
in.oi_baseline: obj? — oi_surge offline: {ticker:{ts,oi_usd_total,vol24h_usd_total,first_seen_ts}} injected — only used together with oi_catalog
in.oi_baseline_path: str? — oi_surge: override the baseline state-file path (default state/oi_surge_baseline.json); a missing file seeds, a corrupt file is LOUD ok:false
in.render: str? — full (default) | compact (SPEC-193: caps excluded/dropped_below_top to a count + 3-item sample)

out.oi_surge_board: (mode=oi_surge) {mode,status,cfg,universe,candidates:[{ticker,venues,oi_usd_total,oi_delta_pct,baseline_age_h,vol24h_usd,vol_oi_ratio,funding_extreme:{venue,pi_4h}?,new_listing:{venue}?,flags,dex_share_pct?,next_step}],excluded:[{ticker,reason}],dropped_below_top:[ticker],meta:{venues_errored}}. status:"seeded" on the baseline store's first run (zero candidates, by design — SPEC-137).

onchain._note: NATIVE (Phase 2). Spine = build_nonce_state: live eth_getTransactionCount per tracked safe diffed vs state/nonce_baseline_<T>.json → ESCALATION when a MAPPED dormant safe fires vs a fresh baseline (SPEC 9: baseline_seeded/baseline_age/baseline_stale, mapped-vs-UNMAPPED confidence). safe_history+recent_flows via Moralis; concentration via GoPlus (top1/top10/holder_count, SPEC 12) — both cover BSC. All layers coverage-labeled, concurrent, never hang. analyse sources its on-chain read from build_nonce_state.

depth.desc: Live order-book shelf read (SPEC 27, +SPEC-84 HL, +SPEC-85 Aster): largest resting bid shelf below + ask wall above per venue (Aster FIRST — the execution venue — then Bitget + Binance cross-check; also surfaces hyperliquid for the ~2/26 overlap names it lists, oracle-marked, omitted otherwise) with price + $size, round-number/spoof tags, and a truncation flag. Read-only intel — NOT an auto-verdict input. (Aster book = TP/exit-shelf anchor only; liq fires off the oracle aggregate, not Aster's DOM — §7.)
depth._note: merge-depth caps ~100 levels; truncated:true means defer to the live DOM, NOT 'no liquidity below'.

regime_check.desc: Cross-venue funding/OI table for one ticker: regime per §2 + divergence (§8) + funding/OI z-scores vs token's own history
regime_check._note: native port of parts-bin regime_check.py. Funding per-interval %. Distinct from regime_flip (single live-vs-stored drift).

price_structure._note: native port of parts-bin price_structure.py. Unlisted ticker → {error}.

liq_magnets._note: native port of parts-bin liq_magnets.py. Approximate — verify trade-critical levels vs the real chart.

out.screener_degraded: str? — SPEC-174 #5: 'coingecko_429'|'coingecko_error' — present when markets() fell back to its 15-min on-disk cache (or came up short) after exhausting per-page 429 backoff retries; absent on a clean live fetch

Coingecko category endpoint (free-tier rate-limited — SPEC-174 #5: each page now retries a 429 with exponential backoff, then falls back to a 15-min on-disk cache, loudly flagged screener_degraded; perp_universe still populates from Binance/Bybit regardless). Second scanner alongside `scan`. Score is a prior, not a verdict.

wallet_state._note: snapshot is native (reads crime-desk/config/tracked_wallets.json, live RPC nonce+balance). audit delegates parts-bin safe_audit.py --json (reads _oldrepo config). Use for raw per-wallet nonce grid; `onchain` for the scored verdict.

onchain_radar.desc: Full onchain-radar feed replacement (SPEC 16): per Cat A token = distributors + accumulators + cost-basis-tagged independent sellers, + tracked-whale Hyperliquid positions near liquidation. Perp-fused, change-detected

in.token: str? — one ticker; omit to sweep all Cat A watchlist names
in.tickers: str? — SPEC 29: comma/list subset to sweep

onchain_radar._note: SPEC 16 = superset of distribution_radar. ONE candidate pass/token yields distributors (HIGH seeded/MED indep, via verify_wallet.distributing) + accumulators (verify_wallet.accumulating = independent net-buyers) + independent_sellers w/ held_days+holder_type (early-winner vs operator dump). perp_liqs = HL clearinghouseState for config/hyperdash_whales.json whales, liq_distance vs live price. Change-detected (or_dist_/or_acc_ state). Full sweep is a periodic cadence tool (~mins).

accumulation_radar.desc: SPEC-76 operator accumulation radar (LONG-side mirror of distribution_radar): watch the mapped operator cluster wallets (team/op/distribution + cross-Cat-A escrows) ACCUMULATE a NEW untracked token, classify active-load vs parked-allocation, cross with perp construction, rank IMMINENT/EARLY/PARK

in.wallet: str? — one operator wallet (omit to sweep the whole cluster)
in.ticker: str? — SPEC-174: scope the result to one off-board token symbol (still sweeps the full cluster; filters the candidate list post-sweep)

out.imminent: list[candidate] — active load + perp firing (the tradeable early-long)
out.ticker: str? — present only when a ticker scope was requested
out.not_found: bool? — SPEC-174: true when a requested ticker matched no cluster-wallet candidate

accumulation_radar._note: SPEC-76. Wallet-centric (vs onchain_radar token-centric). Pipeline: cluster wallets -> ERC20 inbound snapshot + baseline diff (NEW / >50%-GROWN) -> untracked-only -> active(DEX/CEX/open-market) vs parked(vesting/escrow seed) via verify_wallet funded_by -> perp cross (deep-neg trap-formation funding §4 + OI building = firing) -> IMMINENT(active+firing)/EARLY(loaded,perp dormant)/PARK(parked,no perp). Quota: snapshot+diff cadence, cap 40 wallets/run. backtest_lead_time is the §9 go/no-go gate (orchestrator runs it on live history). On-chain accumulation = the spot-side decompose the §4 long gate is missing.

distribution_radar.desc: In-house onchain-radar: DISCOVERS distributing wallets across Cat A watchlist names (seeded-from-safe HIGH + independent-holder MED), perp-fused, change-detected

in.token: str? — one ticker (SPEC-174: also accepts the desk-natural `ticker` key, aliased); omit to sweep all Cat A watchlist names
in.tickers: str? — SPEC 29: comma/list subset to sweep

distribution_radar._note: SPEC 15. Discovery (vs verify_wallet's named-address check): seeded-recipient discovery = inverse of funded_by (tracked safe OUTBOUND→to addrs); independent = GoPlus top holders minus tracked/cex/lp/contracts. HIGH=seeded+distributing, MED=independent+distributing. Change-detected via state/radar_distributors_<T>.json. Moralis+GoPlus (cover BSC). Single token ~15s; full Cat A sweep ~5min (periodic cadence tool, not interactive). Partial-with-labels if a provider rate-limits.

verify_wallet.desc: Ad-hoc on-chain address lookup (§8 intel): funding source (flags seeded-by-tracked-safe), balance, distribution activity, verdict. Moralis-backed (covers BSC). MULTI-CHAIN (SPEC 21): checks every chain the token is deployed on

in.token: str (required) — ticker (needs contract in tracked config); alias: ticker (SPEC-89)
in.chain: str? — restrict to one chain (eth/bsc/base); default = all deployed (SPEC 21)

verify_wallet._note: SPEC 14 + SPEC 21 (multi-chain). Moralis (moralis_api_key) for arbitrary-address token transfers — bscscan free tier rejects BSC. funded_by flags inbound from a tracked team/distribution/passthrough safe as SEEDED-STAGING (§8: not independent). SPEC 21: queries ALL deployed chains and aggregates outflows so a wallet active on a non-default chain (e.g. EDEN team wallets on ETH while default-pick is BSC) is no longer false-DORMANT; `chain` arg restricts to one. Token must have a contract in tracked_wallets config.

onchain_board.desc: On-chain SURVEILLANCE sweep: nonce signal across all tracked watchlist names, alerts on ESCALATION (dormant safe fired). The cadence target
onchain_board._note: cheap nonce-only RPC sweep (no Moralis). Persists each token's baseline, so consecutive sweeps catch a fire — run on a cadence (cron/launchd local, or /loop in-session). alerts=ESCALATION only. SPEC-145: wallets_unreadable/coverage_alerts surface a half-blind sweep instead of reading as a clean QUIET.

analyse.desc: Combined perp+onchain verdict engine: concurrent data layers, 90s on-chain budget (SPEC 1b), §4 neg-funding LONG confluence gate (SPEC 4)
analyse._note: NATIVE port of parts-bin analyse convergence. Pulls perp/onchain/cvd/intraday/oi/whales concurrently from _oldrepo sub-analysers (--json). On-chain capped 90s → onchain:UNAVAILABLE, perp verdict still returns. neg-funding LONG requires full §4 confluence else WATCH. filters/analyse.py retired (kept for the old delegated banner path if ever needed).

setup_score.desc: SPEC 59/82/83 — the §6 setup checklists as deterministic box-counters. score_setup/score_all over a normalized signals snapshot (assembled live from price_structure/live_perp/oi_sides/tape/cvd/onchain/depth; inject signals for offline). Per setup: {score,required,legs:{name:{pass,value,source}},vetoes,swing_vetoes,missing,add_triggers,verdict ARMED|SCOUT|FORMING|VETOED|ABSENT,tier,(add_legs/geometry)}. SCOUT (SPEC-82) = near-armed (score>=required-1): missing legs reframed as add_triggers (size-up, not gates); a chronic-squeezer swing-veto demotes ARMED->SCOUT (scalp-allowed) instead of suppressing. Setups: blowoff (ALL 5), catb_top (4+ of 6), trap_long=neg_funding_gate (§4 ALL 4, veto WASH), stage45_short (4+ of 5), defended_fade_short/long (SPEC-83 ALL 3: wall_growing+empty_beyond+stall; cascade legs ride as add_triggers; geometry entry=level/stop=beyond-wall). Wall-dynamics: derive_wall_growing/record_wall_snapshot (state/wall_history.json, gitignored) make the THICKENING wall visible across snapshots. Hard vetoes: oi_sides WASH, §5 deep-neg SHORT, empty_beyond-false (unsafe fade), DEX-mark, liquidity-gate. Scores only — NO trade calls.

in.payload: JSON {ticker,setup?} (live) OR {setup?,signals{}} (offline). setup omitted = score all.

out.setup: {setup,score,required,legs:{name:{pass,value,source}},vetoes:[str],swing_vetoes:[str],missing:[str],add_triggers:[str],verdict ARMED|SCOUT|FORMING|VETOED|ABSENT,tier armed|scout|null; defended_fade adds add_legs:{name:{pass,value,source}} + geometry:{entry,stop,side}}

workup.desc: SPEC 60 — the §0.6 five-question scan as ONE call. Composes existing capabilities concurrently into chips (onchain concentration/coverage/apparatus), stage (price_structure full-history), oi_construction (live_perp cross-venue funding + oi_sides wash/real + funding_divergence), size (depth books + cvd + liquidity tier + oi_cap), rr (liq_magnets + setup_score SPEC 59 + missing legs), plus flags (squeeze_chronic/venue mark divergence/liquidity tier/alerts). Per-section degrade-explicit; NO verdict field (the Designer judges); meta.ms ~ slow read not sum. Read-only.

out.dossier: {ticker, chips, stage, oi_construction, size, rr, flags, meta{ms,sections}} — each section {available,source,...} or {available:false,reason}; NO verdict

replay.desc: SPEC 62 — backtest the SPEC-59 setup scorers for real §9 base rates. action=fetch (cache 1h klines+funding+OI under state/replay/, idempotent; OI capped 30d by Binance) | run (step bars, score PRICE/OI/FUNDING-computable legs, simulate §6 entry+§7 stop/TP on ARMED, append outcomes) | report (per-signature n/hit%/avg R/max-adverse-excursion + by-symbol) | ledger-import (write rows tagged source:replay, never mixed with live). Replay-able setups: blowoff, catb_top (both SHORT). Engine pure over a bar list — deterministic/reproducible.

unlocks.desc: SPEC-95 — auto-populated token-unlock calendar + pre-unlock (T-3d/T-1d) alerts. ticker-mode: upcoming unlocks for one token SIZED off CANONICAL CoinGecko circulating supply + live price (NOT a single-chain GoPlus total_supply — the BEAT 612k/3431% bug); keyed off cg_id not bare ticker (BEAT=audiera). op=sweep: full-watchlist sweep -> merges upcoming unlocks into config/catalysts.json (manual entries preserved, auto marked source+fetched_ts). op=fire-alerts: fire once-per-event inbox alerts at T-3d/T-1d (cursor-deduped). Source: DefiLlama emissions datasets (free) + config/unlock_seed.json fallback. Coverage-honest: source-down=coverage:false, source-up-no-data=uncovered (never silently 'no unlock').

in.cg_id: str? — explicit CoinGecko id override (identity discipline)

out.uncovered: bool — source up but no events found

unlocks._note: SPEC-95. Auto feed = DefiLlama emissions datasets (key-free; api.llama.fi/emissions is 402, CryptoRank 401). unlock_seed.json = documented fallback for names the feed doesn't track yet (Audiera). classify board + brief read the sweep-populated catalysts.json offline to surface the ⏰ UNLOCK flag (no network in the board/brief path). Pre-unlock alerts wired into ops/surveil.sh. Pairs with stake_schedule (on-chain cliffs) for confirmation.

liqs.desc: SPEC-103 — per-venue forced-liquidation stream as OI ground truth. Corpus rule: aggregate OI is operator-fakeable (double-open 对敲, multi-account internal transfer); liq prints cannot be faked, so a material OI move cross-checked against liq-silence is the tell. Venue: OKX public liquidation-orders REST (live-verified 2026-07-02, keyless, works) — Binance forceOrders is dead on the free path (401/400, matches tape.py's existing finding), kept as a documented seam. oi_liq_consistency verdict: CONFIRMED (real move) / SUSPECT_FAKE (double-open fingerprint) / TRANSFER (multi-account profit-transfer) / UNKNOWN (feed down — never a clean bill) / null (OI move sub-material).

in.oi_delta: float? — the window's OI delta %% for the cross-check verdict

liqs._note: SPEC-103. Read-only ground-truth cross-check — no auto-verdict override, feeds the Designer's operator-lens between triggers (same discipline as tape). tape.py surfaces liq_consistency using its own already-fetched OI series; brief.py's liqs layer feeds the analyse()-computed oi_chg_pct in; workup.py's oi_sides_read gains a liq-silence corroborator when WASH. See REVIEW-REQUEST-SPEC-103.md for the live venue-verification transcript (Binance dead, OKX genuinely public).

oi_mc.desc: SPEC-122 — OI/MC ratio as a 'perp-casino' flag. The ledger's worst signature (SPEC-40) is mindshare/blowoff-top short: n=324, hit 32%, total -26.3R — vertical perp pumps on low-MC names where the game is entirely in the derivatives. oi_mc_ratio = cross-venue OI (USD) / circulating MC (USD): <0.5 normal, 0.5-1.5 PERP_HEAVY, >1.5 PERP_CASINO (EVAA printed 252% live 2026-07-10, DoubleEdge CT intel). PERP_CASINO does not hard-block — it attaches an explicit caveat to a SHORT-direction row so the desk never takes one of these blind.

in.oi_usd: float? — cross-venue OI in USD (omit for a ratio-less MC-only read)
in.mc_usd: float? — circulating market cap in USD (omit to fetch live via CoinGecko)
in.direction: str? — SHORT|LONG, gates the PERP_CASINO caveat

out.oi_mc_ratio: float|null — null when oi_usd or mc_usd is missing/non-positive (§3, never fabricated)
out.oi_mc_caveat: str|null — set only on PERP_CASINO + direction=SHORT

oi_mc._note: SPEC-122. Read-only, never vetoes a trade (an operator-timed OI-unwind short can still work) — wired as an annotation into brief's perp layer, triage's row build, and classify's board annotate pass (annotate_oi_mc), reusing the primary-venue OI each capability already resolves (no second OI fetch); only the MC fetch (CoinGecko via pull5.coingecko_layer) is new I/O, and it degrades to null on any failure.

oi_construction.desc: SPEC-179 — OI-type decomposition (arb-vs-directional, CLAUDE.md §0.6 item 3) + venue-role read (mark-engine/size-book/exit/hedge, §0.6.3b). Five OI types (FUNDING_FARM/VESTING_HEDGE/OPERATOR_AMM/MM_INVENTORY/CROSS_VENUE_FUNDING_ARB), each mandatory-gated — mandatory-alone is never enough to assert. Output is VETO-ONLY (never manufactures confidence); UNKNOWN is first-class with a named reason. CALLS the keyless layer (venue_map/oi_mc/cvd) live; CONSUMES on-chain from EXISTING desk state only (chip_state/flow_confirmed/lock_info are caller-injected — never a fresh Moralis call).

in.chip_state: obj? — injected §2 Cat-A chip-control read from EXISTING state (never fetched here)
in.flow_confirmed: obj? {venue, age_days} — injected tracked operator-deposit-rail termination
in.lock_info: obj? {cliff_date, carry_violation, perp_discount, pristine_chain, hl_direct_observation} — injected stake_schedule read

out.battlefield: obj — the SPEC-177 oi_mc.build_battlefield envelope incl. leverage_state
out.gating_ok: bool — false when the roles block is stale (>4h TTL); stale prints as context, never gates

oi_construction._note: SPEC-179. Pure evaluate_<type>/resolve_<role> functions over injected/already-fetched inputs; build_oi_construction is the only I/O orchestrator (venue_map.build_venue_map, oi_mc.build_battlefield, cvd.resolve_spot_venue, plus the one genuinely new endpoint — fetch_mark_constituents, Aster fapi/v3/indexreferences). G1 contamination rule: a suspected (asserted) OPERATOR_AMM downgrades account-ratio-divergence evidence for every OTHER type on the name. Snapshots append to config/venue_roles.json via --save-roles (never overwritten, history for drift detection).

phase.desc: SPEC-104 — Wyckoff cycle/event classifier (cycle-first breakout gate). Corpus rule (memory: feedback_wyckoff_cycle_first_breakout_gate): the same breakout/breakdown candle is REAL inside accumulation/re-accumulation and BAIT inside distribution — the cycle, not the candle, decides tradability. Heuristics over ML: rule-based SC/AR/ST/SPRING (bottom) and BC/AR/ST/UTAD (top) detectors, config thresholds, every event carries its evidence. Bottom-side reads ACCUMULATION->MARKUP on a confirmed spring+breakout; top-side reads DISTRIBUTION and stays DISTRIBUTION through a UTAD+breakdown (v1 does not emit MARKDOWN — see docs/phase.md). UNCLEAR is a first-class honest answer.
phase._note: SPEC-104. cycle_gate_for(side, cycle) wired into setup_score.py (breakdown/breakout-triggered setups gain a cycle_gate field — a WARNING/CYCLE_CONFLICT, not a hard veto) and brief.py (_phase_layer, the phase: <cycle> one-liner leads the headline). classify_breakout_leg flags the grind_trap_suspect 'one fish eaten twice' fingerprint. Small-coin asymmetry baked in: SPRING requires a prior held SC/AR/ST range — a falling-knife undercut with no held range is never labeled a spring.

trace_tree.desc: SPEC-109 — recursive hop tracer (§8): BFS from a root wallet, reusing verify_wallet.build_verify per node, with a one-line CEX-termination verdict (does any branch of a distribution/fragmentation/rotation tree terminate at a CEX, and at what size?). Replaces ~10 manual verify_wallet rounds (XPIN 2026-07-03 shape) with one call.

in.token: str (required) — ticker (needs contract in tracked config); alias: ticker
in.chain: str? — restrict to one chain (eth/bsc/base); default = all deployed
in.depth: int? (default 3) — max BFS hops from root
in.min_usd: float? (default 1000) — prune edges below this USD size
in.max_fetches: int? (default 25) — hard cap on total wallet fetches per run (Moralis quota)

out.verdict: str — CEX_TERMINATED(...)/NO_CEX_TERMINATION(...), + OPEN_BRANCHES:n when depth-exhausted branches remain
out.skipped: list[str] — addrs not explored due to the fetch budget

trace_tree._note: SPEC-109. Terminal classification reuses verify_wallet._classify_addr + onchain.classify_destination (kind=cex/tier cex-hot/exchange -> cex; kind=dex or SPEC-94 dex-router/dex-execution -> dex, never recursed). No new vendor dependency — fetch layer is verify_wallet.build_verify (Moralis-backed, quota-metered). Budget guard defaults to 25 wallet fetches/run; a cap hit marks truncated:true + skipped + OPEN_BRANCHES in the verdict (never silently 'clean').

sector_divergence.desc: SPEC-114 — SOLO_PUMP vs SECTOR_MOVE Cat A pre-classifier: token return vs its sector/narrative basket (Onchain-Analysis-Workshop-CrimeDesk.md Lesson 10). A prior, not a gate — re-ranks/annotates, never suppresses.

in.token_ret: float (required) — the token's own % return for the window

out.baskets: list[<same shape as strongest>] — every basket the token is mapped to

sector_divergence._note: SPEC-114. Baskets in config/sector_baskets.json (cg_category or cg_ids, keyed by basket name) + token_baskets mapping. Wired as a `sector` key (only when mapped — unmapped rows stay byte-identical) into classify.classify_token, triage._build_row, and screener.build_screen (cheap path: screener's own fetched CG page IS the bsc-microcap basket).

dex_execution.desc: SPEC-115 — DEX execution detector: large swaps by tracked-cluster wallets or their SPEC-98 fresh-wallet children at known routers/pools, sized off the quote/stable leg. EXECUTION (visible, direct cause) vs POSITIONING (a CEX deposit, inferred) — memory: feedback_predictor_vs_cause_dex_sale_is_execution.

out.reason: str? — present when available:false (provider down / untracked token / no known dex addresses — never a clean 'no execution' bill, §3)
out.hits: list[{direction:sell|buy, usd, pool, tx_hash, timestamp, sender, attribution:{kind:tracked|fresh_child,cluster,parent}|null, exploit_dump?:{tx_hash,pct_float,timestamp,from}}]

dex_execution._note: SPEC-115. Known routers = SPEC-94-reclassified 0x238a3588 + apparatus-tier 0xb300000b (both valid swap venues — operator-specificity comes from the sender) + known_entities.json DEX hints. Wired as the THIRD rotation_freshness evidence leg (FROZEN→ROTATED, cited senior to the CEX-inference leg) — rides through existing onchain/brief distribution_freshness surfacing with no further wiring.

drip_seller.desc: SPEC-117 — drip/DCA-pattern seller detector: recurring, metronomic same-direction executions (DEX swaps and/or CEX-channel deposits) per wallet, individually below SPEC-115's per-swap floor but cumulatively price-relevant (the ESPORTS ~$530K drip-bot lesson).

out.reason: str? — present when available:false (provider down / untracked token / no known dex-or-CEX addresses — never a clean 'no drip' bill, §3)
out.hits: list[{verdict:DRIP_SELLER|DRIP_BUYER, wallet, direction:sell|buy, channel, channel_kind:dex-swap|cex-deposit, cumulative_usd, tx_count, median_gap_sec, first_ts, last_ts, run_rate_usd_per_day, attribution:{kind:tracked|fresh_child,cluster,parent}|null}]

drip_seller._note: SPEC-117. Reuses dex_execution.size_swap_hits (min_usd:0 — the per-swap floor disabled by design) and discover_fresh_children (not re-derived). Wired as a FOURTH rotation_freshness evidence leg alongside `dex` (same seniority — both confirmed on-chain execution) — rides through existing onchain/brief distribution_freshness surfacing with no further wiring.

deposit_breadth.desc: SPEC-118 — deposit-breadth metric: many DISTINCT, largely untracked senders depositing to known CEX channels at once (Lesson 8 predictor #2) — the pattern-level aggregate the desk's subject-level (tracked-wallet) layer structurally misses (VELVET). Deliberately NOT gated on tracked_wallets.

out.reason: str? — present when available:false (provider down / no known CEX channels — never a clean 'no breadth' bill, §3)
out.baseline: float — mean sender count over the persisted prior windows
out.decomposition: {tracked:int, fresh:int, unknown:int} — corroboration AFTER detection, never a gate
out.line: str — the BREADTH_SPIKE/breadth: ... render line, numbers always

deposit_breadth._note: SPEC-118. Baseline persisted per-token in state/deposit_breadth_<TICKER>.json (rolling window history) — cold-start has no baseline yet, so SPIKE can't fire on the first read. Wired as a FIFTH rotation_freshness evidence leg alongside `onchain` (same seniority — both inferred deposit activity) — rides through existing onchain/brief distribution_freshness surfacing with no further wiring.

claim_topup.desc: SPEC-119: claim/distributor top-up tripwire. Registry-gated (config/tracked_wallets.json wallet kind:claim-distributor) — an inbound transfer to a registered distributor clearing an absolute-USD or %-float floor is a TOP-UP: a HIGH inbox event, source-classified, linked to any unlocks/stake_schedule calendar cliff (unscheduled if none). --fire-alerts is the sweep hook (ops/surveil.sh cadence, alongside unlocks.py --fire-alerts — no new loop). Provider-down on one distributor reports unavailable, never a false quiet.

in.op: str? — read|fire-alerts (default read; fire-alerts sweeps every registered ticker)

claim_topup._note: reuses onchain.token_transfers (SPEC-97/101/102 provider seam) and unlocks.next_catalyst_for; unlocks.build_unlocks carries a live top-up in its claim_topup field (recent_annotation, decay_window_h).

venue_map.desc: SPEC-129 — full cross-venue coverage sweep (§0.6.3b): which venues list this perp and where is the book. CEX four (binance/bybit/aster/bitget) + hyperliquid + the DEX long tail (lighter/paradex/extended/vest), one concurrent probe per venue (~6s each, sweep ≤20s live). §3 doctrine: a probe error/timeout is status:error, NEVER rendered as not_listed and never a 0 datum; not_listed is a venue answering clean with no market. Read-only — no thesis/verdict fields.

out.funding_extreme: {venue,pi_4h}|null — most-extreme (max abs) non-floor 4h-normalized print across ALL listed venues (SPEC-108 convention)

venue_map._note: reuses regime_flip.to_4h/_is_floor/binance_interval_min/bybit_interval_min (existing normalization/floor layer) and hyperliquid.resolve/universe/is_floor (existing HL source); new code is the DEX adapters (lighter/paradex/extended/vest) plus a not_listed/error-distinguishing fetch wrapper regime_flip.fetch() doesn't provide. Vest's documented endpoint (serverprod.vest.exchange) returned Cloudflare 530 at build/verify time 2026-07-29 — implemented per docs.vest.exchange anyway; a dead origin exercises status:error like any other outage. brief/analyse integration (surface top_oi_venue when it diverges from the briefed venue) is a follow-on spec.

venue_bars.desc: SPEC-188 — all-venue 1h OHLC sweep + cross-venue dispersion, the deterministic engine layer behind the §3 all-venue structure rule (user directive repeated 2026-09-01/09-02 — hand discipline failed twice). Fourteen keyless venues (binance/bybit/okx/bitget/kucoin/gate/mexc/htx/bingx/hyperliquid/aster/kraken/blofin/coinbase) fanned out concurrently, ~2s live for OP/BTC. A venue that fails is status available:false+reason — loud, never dropped (§3 zero-print rule). level_agreement() answers the tape-agreement read for one committed level.

in.interval: str? — default 1h (only 1h verified against every venue's own granularity string)
in.n: int? — closed bars to pull, default 6 (plus the live/forming bar)

out.dominant_tape: {venue,turnover_24h_usd}|null — max 24h turnover across venues that reported one; NOT the same venue as venue_map's OI-based top_oi_venue
out.execution_venue: str — always aster (§7: fills happen there)

venue_bars._note: same adapter-isolation/probe-injection pattern as venue_map.py (SPEC-129) reused for bars instead of funding/OI. turnover_24h_usd verified live for 10/14 venues (binance/bybit/okx/bitget/kucoin/mexc/htx/bingx/aster/hyperliquid); gate/kraken/blofin/coinbase report null rather than a guessed figure — dominant_tape is computed over whichever venues DID report one. Kraken uses its own XBT/BTC symbol convention (KRAKEN_SYMBOL_ALIASES). Consumed by brief (tape block + tape-agreement lines, SPEC-188 §2) and classify (venue_agreement on price-leg events, SPEC-188 §3).

perpfinder.desc: SPEC-151 — PerpFinder keyless breadth API, SECOND-SOURCE ONLY (never verdict-gating). funding-rates: 2205 symbols x 27 venues in one keyless call, 1h-normalized (funding_pi_4h = rate1h x 4, normalized:true always) so placeholder-floor detection is impossible on it — venue-native prints stay authoritative for any funding verdict. open-interest/volume are venue-level aggregates (not per-asset). oi-long-short is currently empty on the live API (rows:[], empty_reason). slippage/funding-history are majors-only, useless for the desk's micro-cap book. liquidations is a genuine multi-venue liq event stream (sourced from Coinalyze) — breadth next to liqs.py's OKX-native ground truth, never a replacement. Not wired into venue_map/scan/regime_check/brief (explicit non-goal) — a follow-on spec adds it as a cross-check column once hand-verified against venue-native prints on ≥3 names.

in.ticker: str? — filter the funding/liqs matrix to one asset; asset for slippage/funding_history (defaults BTC)
in.venues: list[str]? — filter funding/liqs rows to these venues
in.size: float? — slippage mode, required with side
in.side: enum[buy,sell]? — slippage mode, required with size

out.rows|byExchange|exchanges|events: list — shape DIFFERS per mode, see docs/perpfinder.md table (no uniform envelope)
out.meta: {source:"perpfinder", normalized?, updatedAt, dataStatus, schemaVersion, warning?, attribution}

perpfinder._note: EVAL-loris.md (2026-07-29, §2 doctrine) established the bar this clears: keyless/free/CORS-open/self-describing, unlike loris (paid key or scraping a private endpoint). Live-verified 2026-08-19/20 — the ticket text is superseded by its own addenda where they conflict; docs/perpfinder.md is the build record.
